inputs.text: Pixar-style 3D animated feature film, polished expressive character animation, warm cinematic family-film lighting. One continuous locked medium-wide shot inside a cozy living room, looking toward the front door. A teenage boy with short messy black hair, blue T-shirt, gray jeans, and white sneakers stands beside one large tied black garbage bag. A game controller rests on the sofa behind him and the television glows softly. The boy looks down at the garbage bag, freezes for one beat, then his shoulders slowly sink as he releases a long weary sigh. Very slowly he reaches toward the tied top of the bag with only two fingers. Before touching it, he hesitates and turns his head to look back longingly at the television. He is reluctant but will comply; no anger, fear, sadness, or refusal. Clear readable body language, restrained natural motion, coherent hands and feet, stable character and room, fixed camera, no cuts, no dialogue, no captions.
